::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 25th 1893  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Yale University, Beinecke Library, Osborn Files 41.22
:::

My [Lord Bishop](people/person_165.qmd)
In answer to your appeal I send £5 from myself /10 from a friend\\ to Messrs Coutts.[^1]  I write because I see you wish to be informed of what is paid in for your intended buildings

I remain respectfully
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Rt. Rev. George Francis Popham Blyth  (1832–1914), bishop of Jerusalem and the East, had founded the Jerusalem and the East Mission Fund in 1890.

**Note:** On 3 October 1893 a cheque for £5 10s. was recorded as being paid from CMY’s account at Hoare’s to the Jerusalem & East Mission Fund.
